title: erica multiflora f. alba
intro: Erica multiflora f. alba, commonly known as White Heath Heath, is a flowering plant species within the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Erica multiflora f. alba are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and essential oils that exhibit sedative and adaptogenic effects. Research on the bioactive constituents of Erica multiflora f. alba has identified the presence of flavonoids, including quercetin and kaempferol, as well as phenolic acids and volatile oils.
